nodes.asset_description: Full-canvas collage divided by bold white diagonal bands forming a central white diamond. Top-left quadrant: soft pink backdrop with four white cosmetic containers (tube, jar, small tube, and clear dropper bottle with silver collar) lit with hard shadows. Top-right quadrant: diagonal split yellow (upper) and orange (lower) background with citrus slices and green leaves casting strong shadows. Bottom-left quadrant: warm tan and pale cream paper surfaces with a white pump bottle, a round white bath bomb, and a lip balm tube; all casting crisp shadows. Bottom-right quadrant: gray wall above white marble countertop; a small beige bowl holds two clear bottles filled with pink liquid, black caps, partially wrapped in a cream waffle-textured cloth.
